why: Both involve moderator-staged April Fools changes and members reacting, so the Breadman makeover items require separating playing inside the takeover from testing what the joke means.

why.T3-001: Members post their own fake April Fools hockey scares (player-of-month, Coach Q departure, Kane injury, mustache) and replies fall for or react inside them.

why.T3-017: The concepts are ordinary side talk (Formula 1 fandom) inside a canvas attack thread, with no canvas work or April Fools fake as their point.

why.T3-006: The concepts call for or report attacks to deface and black out rival hockey logos (Blues, Calgary, Maple Leafs, Jets), rather than settling borders or converting a mark into the room's own sign.

why.T3-009: The main concepts mark the finished logo as achieved: WE DID IT, beautiful, made it to the end, survived to the final portrait.
why.T3-043: Distinct concepts explicitly thank or credit participants, the template designer, and helpers for making the work possible.

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: T3-009 celebrates the finished work but does not carry the explicit thanks and credit to the template designer and helpers.
multiplacement_log.why_this_one: C0211331, C0926811 and C1436085 thank or credit named makers and helpers of the work, satisfying T3-043's gate.
multiplacement_log.dispensable: Drop T3-043 if forced to one; lose the specific credit to makers and designers, while T3-009 still carries the finished-work celebration.

why.T3-095: Members ask for context and work out what the Breadman posts and the moderators' April Fools joke mean, whether bread pictures remain allowed, and the mods close the joke.

why.T3-073: The item reports what happened to the KSU work after the close: destroyed in the last minutes, did not survive shutdown, locked, missing the final thirty minutes.

why.T3-011: The largest share sends pixels or defence to other rooms' works (Formula 1, Red Wings, Wild/Preds/Stars, Bears coalition, central brothers). Other themes at the floor are T3-150 alliances, T3-084 asking other rooms for help, T3-151 reciprocal help, and T3-010 border or space agreements.

why.T3-005: The leading concepts are alarms, calls, vows, and reports of defending the Chief against Blues, Preds, Void and colour attacks. Other themes at the floor are T3-021 repair/upkeep, T3-103 dividing parts, T3-038 building, and T3-087 tracing attackers.

why.T3-076: Members tell the room to stop destroying the Blues logo, move fights to the ice, and redirect effort to their own mark.
why.T3-024: Distinct concepts choose space and changes that spare surrounding art and let rival work stay.

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: T3-076 stops the room's attacks but does not carry the positive decision to spare surrounding art and let rival work remain.
multiplacement_log.why_this_one: C0430995, C0568113 and C1069113 show the room choosing its work so it does not ruin surrounding art or destroy a rival logo.
multiplacement_log.dispensable: Drop T3-024 if forced to one; lose the explicit non-covering/sparing element, while T3-076 still carries the turn from attacking.

why.T3-027: The concepts argue whether scripts and bots are fair, cheating, against raw manpower, or acceptable protection, without actually running a room script.

why.T3-033: The primary concepts offer the room ideas for a Hawks mark: four feathers, tomahawk C, shoulder patch, Indian head, or a logo of their own. Other themes at the floor are T3-004 design settling, T3-070 coordinates/templates, and T3-002 calls to place.

why.T3-084: KSU asks r/NEU as a room for help making KSU bigger and seconds the request for any help; the welcome and praise are subordinate greetings.

why.T3-023: The sub is given a Breadman/Panarin makeover and members fill it with bread images, Russian words, and Breadman jokes.
why.T3-100: Distinct concepts ask to keep the Breadman makeover forever, until a Cup, or to bring the theme back.

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: T3-023 stages and plays the moderator-led Breadman takeover but does not carry requests for that April Fools change to outlive the day.
multiplacement_log.why_this_one: C1021885, C0225662 and C0620848 ask to keep the Breadman theme forever, until a Cup, or bring it back.
multiplacement_log.dispensable: Drop T3-100 if forced to one; lose the retention request, while T3-023 still carries the makeover and play inside it.

why.T3-095: Members ask for context and work out what the Breadman posts and moderators' April Fools joke mean, whether bread pictures remain allowed, and the mods close the joke.
